nbe3bb4fb847.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the devolution criteria of the 15th and 16th Finance Commissions?
o: The weight for area declined from 15% to 10%
The weight for forest and ecology remained at 10% under both
The 16th Finance Commission retained tax and fiscal effort as a criterion
The weight for demographic performance was reduced from 12.5% to 10%
nbe3bb4fb847.x: The 16th Finance Commission dropped tax and fiscal effort as a criterion; the other three changes are correct.

n2f30372e163.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the qualifications of Finance Commission members under the Finance Commission (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act, 1951?
o: The Chairman should have experience in public affairs
One member must be an expert in monetary policy operations
One member should be a High Court judge or qualified to be one
One member should have special knowledge of government finance and accounts
n2f30372e163.x: The Act names no expert in monetary policy operations; the other members are experts in government finance and accounts, financial matters and administration, and economics.

nf07d8906640.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the local-body grants recommended by the 16th Finance Commission for 2026-31?
o: The total grant for local bodies is ₹7.91 lakh crore
Rural local bodies get about ₹4.35 lakh crore
The urban share of local-body grants is 45%
Urban local bodies get about ₹4.35 lakh crore
nf07d8906640.x: The figures are the other way round: urban local bodies get about ₹3.56 lakh crore and rural local bodies about ₹4.35 lakh crore.

n5f9cb11bdcf.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the population data used by Finance Commissions?
o: The 15th Finance Commission used only the 1971 population
The 14th Finance Commission used both the 1971 and 2011 population
The 16th Finance Commission used the 2011 population
The 16th Finance Commission measured demographic performance against the 1971 population
n5f9cb11bdcf.x: The 15th Finance Commission used the 2011 population, not the 1971 figure.

n596c910b141.s: Which of the following pairs (Finance Commission – States' share in the divisible pool) is correctly matched?
n596c910b141.x: The 15th Finance Commission recommended 41%, the fall from the 14th FC's 42% reflecting the change in status of Jammu and Kashmir; the 16th FC retained 41%.

n4a80819c827.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Comptroller and Auditor-General of India?
o: He holds office for six years or until the age of 65, whichever is earlier
He holds office during the pleasure of the President
He is removed in the same manner and on the same grounds as a Supreme Court judge
After ceasing to hold office, he is not eligible for further office under the Union or any State
n4a80819c827.x: The CAG does not hold office at the President's pleasure; he can be removed only like a Supreme Court judge.

nc66f4f5926d.s: Which of the following pairs relating to the audit of public sector entities is wrongly matched?
o: RBI – Supplementary audit by the CAG after private auditors are appointed on its advice
DVC – Audited directly by the CAG
ONGC – Audited directly by the CAG
Central Warehousing Corporation – Private auditors on the CAG's advice, with supplementary audit by the CAG
nc66f4f5926d.x: The RBI is wholly audited by private auditors; the CAG has no supplementary role there.

n5ff53bdecd4.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the audit jurisdiction of the CAG?
o: He audits the Consolidated Fund of India
He audits the Consolidated Funds of States and of UTs having legislatures
He audits only expenditure and not receipts
He audits the Contingency Funds and Public Accounts
n5ff53bdecd4.x: The CAG audits both receipts and expenditure.

nd5b71a1e787.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Public Accounts Committee?
o: It was set up in 1921 under the Government of India Act, 1919
It has 22 members: 15 from the Lok Sabha and 7 from the Rajya Sabha
It has been chaired by a member of the Opposition since 1967
A Minister can be a member of the Committee
nd5b71a1e787.x: A Minister cannot be a member of the Public Accounts Committee.

nindian-polity-80-30.s: Which of the following pairs relating to the CAG is wrongly matched?
o: Audit report on Union accounts – Submitted to the President
Audit report on State accounts – Submitted to the President
Form of accounts of the Union and States – Prescribed by the President on the CAG's advice
Appointment of the CAG – By warrant under the President's hand and seal
nindian-polity-80-30.x: The audit report on State accounts is submitted to the Governor, not the President (Article 151).

nc1903adcb6e.s: Which of the following falls within the audit jurisdiction of the CAG?
o: Local bodies automatically in every case
Secret service expenditure, in the same manner as ordinary expenditure
Government companies and bodies substantially financed by the government
Day-to-day control over the issue of money from the treasury
nc1903adcb6e.x: Government companies and bodies substantially financed by the government are audited by the CAG; local bodies are audited only on request, not automatically.

nindian-polity-80-37.s: From which date was the CAG relieved of the duty of compiling Union accounts?
nindian-polity-80-37.x: The CAG stopped compiling Union accounts from 1 March 1976, when accounting was separated from audit; Union accounts are now compiled by the CGA under the Ministry of Finance.

n1bb516007bb.s: Which of the following audits conducted by the CAG are obligatory?
o: Compliance audit and financial attest audit
Financial attest audit and performance audit
n1bb516007bb.x: Compliance and financial attest audits are obligatory, while performance audit is discretionary.

n4417b715432.s: The salary and service conditions of the CAG are provided in which Schedule of the Constitution?
n4417b715432.x: The CAG's salary and service conditions are provided in the Second Schedule, and they cannot be varied to his disadvantage after appointment.

nindian-polity-78-16.s: The Chairman and members of a State Public Service Commission hold office for six years or until the age of:
nindian-polity-78-16.x: State PSC members serve six years or until 62, whichever is earlier; UPSC members serve six years or until 65.

nbbbee734b84.s: In relation to secret service expenditure, the CAG:
o: Audits it in the same manner as ordinary expenditure
Audits it only on the request of the President
Audits it in a closed session with the Public Accounts Committee
Accepts a certificate from the competent authority
nbbbee734b84.x: The CAG cannot audit secret service expenditure; he accepts a certificate from the competent authority instead.

nc44cafdcc6c.s: The recommendations of the Public Accounts Committee are:
o: Binding once accepted by the Speaker
Binding on the Finance Ministry alone
nc44cafdcc6c.x: PAC recommendations are not binding on the executive, which is one reason for the reported backlog of Action Taken Notes.

nindian-polity-80-10.s: Which Article of the Constitution deals with the audit reports of the Union and the States?
nindian-polity-80-10.x: Article 151 deals with audit reports; 148 provides for the CAG, 149 his duties and powers, and 150 the form of accounts.

nindian-polity-80-18.s: Who is described as the 'friend, philosopher and guide' of the Public Accounts Committee?
nindian-polity-80-18.x: The CAG assists the PAC and is called its 'friend, philosopher and guide'.

nc1e1736bf87.s: Which audit examines the economy, efficiency and effectiveness of government schemes?
nc1e1736bf87.x: Performance audit tests economy, efficiency and effectiveness; propriety audit examines wisdom, faithfulness and economy in expenditure.

nindian-polity-80-14.s: Which of the following is a function of the CAG?
o: Controlling the issue of money from the treasury
Prescribing the form of accounts of the Union
nindian-polity-80-14.x: Performance audit is a CAG function; he cannot prosecute or control treasury withdrawals, and the form of accounts is prescribed by the President on his advice.

n3d3f9d6b317.s: Which audit checks whether money was legally available and spent as the rules require?
n3d3f9d6b317.x: Compliance (legal and regulatory) audit checks legal availability and rule-bound spending; financial attest audit checks that accounts are true.

nindian-polity-80-13.s: Which one of the following is NOT a function of the CAG?
o: Auditing expenditure from the Consolidated Fund of India
Auditing Contingency Funds and Public Accounts
Day-to-day control over the issue of money from the treasury
Auditing stores, stocks and government companies
nindian-polity-80-13.x: The CAG does not control treasury issues day to day; the other three are within his audit.

nindian-polity-80-57.s: The removal of the CAG is governed by Article 148(1) read with which Article?
nindian-polity-80-57.x: Article 148(1) read with Article 124(4) applies the Supreme Court judge's removal process to the CAG.

nindian-polity-80-7.s: The CAG can be removed on an address by both Houses of Parliament, passed by special majority, on the ground of:
o: An adverse report of the Public Accounts Committee
nindian-polity-80-7.x: Like a Supreme Court judge, the CAG is removed for proved misbehaviour or incapacity on an address by both Houses passed by special majority.

nindian-polity-80-34.s: The CAG of India does not control the issue of money from the treasury because he functions only as:
nindian-polity-80-34.x: The Indian CAG is only an Auditor General, auditing after expenditure, so he exercises no prior control over treasury issues.

nindian-polity-78-9.s: Which Constitutional Amendment raised the retirement age of High Court judges from 60 to 62 years?
nindian-polity-78-9.x: The 15th Constitutional Amendment Act, 1963 raised the retirement age of High Court judges from 60 to 62.

nindian-polity-80-28.s: The form of accounts of the Union and the States is prescribed by the President on the advice of the:
nindian-polity-80-28.x: Under Article 150, the President prescribes the form of accounts on the CAG's advice.

nindian-polity-32-11.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Attorney General and the Solicitor General of India?
o: The Attorney General holds office during the pleasure of the President
The Attorney General has rights in Parliament under Article 88
The Solicitor General has rights in Parliament under Article 88
The Solicitor General has a fixed statutory term
nindian-polity-32-11.x: The Solicitor General has no floor rights in Parliament; Article 88 rights belong to the Attorney General.

na0f0b43d55e.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Attorney General and the Advocate General?
o: The Advocate General's remuneration is determined by the President
The Attorney General is qualified to be a Supreme Court judge
The Advocate General is qualified to be a High Court judge
The Advocate General holds office during the pleasure of the Governor
na0f0b43d55e.x: The Advocate General's remuneration is determined by the Governor; only the Attorney General's is fixed by the President.

n45786cc3e94.s:
Assertion (A): The Advocate General may speak and take part in the proceedings of either House of the State Legislature and its committees.
Reason (R): The Advocate General has a right to vote in the proceedings in which he or she participates.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n45786cc3e94.x: Under Article 177 the Advocate General may speak and participate in the Legislature and its committees, but has no right to vote.

nindian-polity-32-10.s: Who appoints the Solicitor General of India?
nindian-polity-32-10.x: The Solicitor General is appointed by the Appointments Committee of the Cabinet, while the President appoints the Attorney General.

n47cf0784343.s: The normal term of the Solicitor General of India is:
n47cf0784343.x: The Solicitor General, India's second law officer, normally has a three-year term.

nf3a8cdaf37b.s: The remuneration of the Advocate General of a State is determined by the:
nf3a8cdaf37b.x: The Governor appoints the Advocate General, who holds office at the Governor's pleasure and receives remuneration the Governor determines.

n49c08be7a94.s: Who is the highest law officer of India?
n49c08be7a94.x: The Attorney General is the first law officer of India; he is not a member of the Union Cabinet.

nindian-polity-32-4.s: Which Article of the Constitution provides for the Advocate General of a State?
nindian-polity-32-4.x: The Advocate General is provided for under Article 165 (Part VI); the Attorney General under Article 76 (Part V).

nindian-polity-31-12.s: To qualify as Attorney General of India, an advocate must have practised in a High Court for at least:
nindian-polity-31-12.x: The Attorney General needs Supreme Court judge qualifications: a High Court judge for 5 years, a High Court advocate for 10 years, or an eminent jurist in the President's opinion.

nindian-polity-32-6.s: The Advocate General of a State holds office during the pleasure of the:
nindian-polity-32-6.x: The Advocate General serves at the Governor's pleasure, not that of the Cabinet or the Chief Minister.

nindian-polity-31-11.s: The Attorney General of India submits his resignation to the:
nindian-polity-31-11.x: The Attorney General resigns to the President and, by convention, quits when the Council of Ministers changes.

nf84af622bef.s: Who was the first Attorney General of India?
nf84af622bef.x: M.C. Setalvad was India's first Attorney General.

ndcb9c3afc95.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the civil-court powers of the National Commission while investigating a matter?
o: It can summon and examine a person on oath
It can require the discovery and production of documents
It can requisition public records from a court or office
It cannot issue commissions for the examination of witnesses
ndcb9c3afc95.x: The Commission can issue commissions for examining witnesses, along with summoning persons, requiring documents, receiving affidavits and requisitioning records.

n530aefcf95e.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the 65th Constitutional Amendment?
o: It replaced the original Special Officer for SCs and STs
It created the separate National Commission for STs under Article 338A
It replaced the commission established by the 1987 Resolution
The separate NCST under Article 338A came later, through the 89th Amendment
n530aefcf95e.x: The separate NCST under Article 338A came through the 89th Amendment, not the 65th.

n021d7f81ab9.s:
Assertion (A): The National Commission for Scheduled Castes consists of a Chairperson, a Vice-Chairperson and three members.
Reason (R): The members of the Commission are appointed by the President by warrant under his hand and seal.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n021d7f81ab9.x: Both are true: the Commission has five members and they are appointed by the President by warrant, but the mode of appointment does not explain its composition.

nindian-society-1-19.s: Which Constitutional Amendment gave constitutional status to the National Commission for Backward Classes?
nindian-society-1-19.x: The 102nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 2018 gave the NCBC constitutional status.

nf9d728a2244.s: Who was the first chairperson of the separate National Commission for Scheduled Tribes constituted in 2004?
nf9d728a2244.x: Kunwar Singh was the first NCST chairperson (2004); Suraj Bhan headed the first separate NCSC and S.H. Ramdhan the combined commission (1992).

n214ca0f0476.s: The National Commission for Backward Classes is provided for under:
n214ca0f0476.x: The NCSC, NCST and NCBC fall under Articles 338, 338A and 338B respectively.

nindian-society-1-69.s: The first Backward Classes Commission, set up in 1953, was headed by:
nindian-society-1-69.x: Kaka Kalelkar chaired the first Backward Classes Commission (1953); B.P. Mandal chaired the second.

n958c7529447.s: Which of the following was NOT added as a deemed member of the NHRC by the 2019 amendment?
o: Chairperson of the National Commission for Women
Chairperson of the National Commission for Backward Classes
Chairperson of the National Commission for Protection of Child Rights
Chief Commissioner for Persons with Disabilities
n958c7529447.x: The NCW chairperson was already a deemed member before 2019; the amendment added the NCBC and NCPCR chairpersons and the Chief Commissioner for Persons with Disabilities.

n11db5fde6d8.s: Which of the following pairs (Commission – Present Chairperson) is wrongly matched?
o: National Commission for Women – Vijaya Rahatkar
National Human Rights Commission – Justice V. Ramasubramanian
National Commission for Scheduled Castes – Antar Singh Arya
National Commission for Scheduled Tribes – Antar Singh Arya
n11db5fde6d8.x: Kishor Makwana chairs the NCSC; Antar Singh Arya chairs the NCST.

n1c6255bd946.s:
Assertion (A): The National Commission for Women may appoint committees for particular purposes.
Reason (R): The National Commission for Women has no power to regulate its own procedure.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n1c6255bd946.x: The NCW can appoint committees and co-opt outsiders, and it may also regulate its own procedure, so R is false.

n43993adb55f.s: Who was the first Chairperson of the National Commission for Women?
n43993adb55f.x: Jayanti Patnaik was the first NCW Chairperson; Vijaya Rahatkar is the present one.

n54f6a3e7604.s: State Human Rights Commissions are established under the:
o: Commissions for Protection of Child Rights Act, 2005
n54f6a3e7604.x: SHRCs are set up under the Protection of Human Rights Act, 1993; human-rights functions in Delhi remain with the NHRC.

n38ec88f1434.s: After the 2019 amendment, the term of office of the NHRC Chairperson and members is:
o: Five years or until the age of 70
Three years or until the age of 65
Three years or until the age of 70
Five years or until the age of 65
n38ec88f1434.x: Since 2019 the term is three years or until 70, whichever is earlier; earlier it was five years.

nb0b97654345.s: Who chairs the selection committee for appointing the NHRC Chairperson and members?
nb0b97654345.x: The Prime Minister chairs the six-member committee, which includes the Union Home Minister and the Deputy Chairman of the Rajya Sabha.

n53e4eb95998.s: In which year was CEDAW adopted?
n53e4eb95998.x: CEDAW was adopted in 1979; the Convention against Torture followed in 1984.

n4b901da7d15.s: The NCPCR monitors the implementation of which of the following Acts?
o: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
n4b901da7d15.x: The NCPCR monitors the POCSO Act, 2012, along with the RTE Act, 2009 and the Juvenile Justice Act, 2015.

n2fd1637255a.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the powers associated with the Lokpal?
o: Its Prosecution Wing files cases before the Special Court
Tainted property can be attached only after the prosecution is over
It exercises superintendence and direction over the CBI in cases it refers
It may summon persons and requisition records like a civil court
n2fd1637255a.x: Property acquired by corrupt means can be attached and confiscated even while the prosecution is pending.

n4add6b2fcbd.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the jurisdiction of the Lokpal?
o: It covers anything said or any vote given by an MP in Parliament
It extends to Union Ministers and Members of Parliament
It applies to Indian public servants both within and outside India
It covers bodies set up by an Act of Parliament or funded by the government
n4add6b2fcbd.x: Anything said or any vote given by an MP in Parliament is outside the Lokpal's jurisdiction.

n9c008a15563.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Selection Committee of the Lokpal?
o: The Prime Minister is its Chairperson
The Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha is a member
An eminent jurist is nominated by the President on the other members' recommendation
The Chairman of the Rajya Sabha is an ex officio member
n9c008a15563.x: The Chairman of the Rajya Sabha is not a member of the Lokpal Selection Committee.

n8f1d524a2e8.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the declaration of assets under the Lokpal and Lokayuktas law?
o: The original law covered the public servant, spouse and dependent children
The declaration was required within 30 days of entering office
The 2016 amendment placed the form and manner of declaration in the Constitution
After 2016, the form and manner are prescribed by the Central Government
n8f1d524a2e8.x: The 2016 amendment left the form and manner to be prescribed by the Central Government, not by the Constitution.

n93ff31f4183.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Search Committee for the Lokpal?
o: It may have fewer than seven persons
It is constituted by the Selection Committee
It prepares a panel for consideration
At least half its members must be from SCs, STs, OBCs, minorities and women
n93ff31f4183.x: The Search Committee must have at least seven persons.

nd872a55c2f9.s:
Assertion (A): In Andhra Pradesh, the Lokayukta deals with complaints against higher functionaries and the Upa-Lokayukta with the remaining functionaries.
Reason (R): The Chief Minister and Members of the Legislative Assembly are covered by the Andhra Pradesh Lokayukta.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nd872a55c2f9.x: Both are true: the two bodies have differentiated functions and coverage includes the CM and MLAs, but coverage does not explain the division of work.

nb1baf100318.s: An eminent person may be appointed Chairperson of the Lokpal if he or she has at least ____ years' experience in specified fields.
nb1baf100318.x: Besides a former CJI or Supreme Court judge, an eminent person with 25 years' relevant experience may be Lokpal Chairperson.

nindian-polity-22-47.s: Which of the following is NOT a member of the Lokpal Selection Committee?
nindian-polity-22-47.x: The Rajya Sabha Chairman is not a member; the PM chairs the committee, and the Speaker and the CJI (or a Supreme Court judge he nominates) are members.

n7ad6fba5d28.s: The State Vigilance Commission in Andhra Pradesh was set up, on the pattern of the CVC, from:
n7ad6fba5d28.x: The AP State Vigilance Commission was set up from 1964 on the CVC pattern; trap cases are handled by the Anti-Corruption Bureau.

n5f9e6dd46a4.s: Allegations against the Prime Minister relating to which of the following are excluded from the Lokpal's jurisdiction?
o: International relations, security, public order, atomic energy and space
n5f9e6dd46a4.x: All these areas, namely international relations, security, public order, atomic energy and space, are excluded from the Lokpal's jurisdiction over the Prime Minister.

n1135d5f5914.s: In which year did the Lok Sabha pass the First Lokpal Bill?
n1135d5f5914.x: The First Lokpal Bill, introduced in the Lok Sabha, was passed by it in 1969 and lapsed on the dissolution of that Lok Sabha.

n92463e43c30.s: A preliminary inquiry under the Lokpal framework is ordinarily to be completed within:
n92463e43c30.x: A preliminary inquiry ordinarily takes 90 days, extendable by 90 more days for reasons recorded in writing.

n195b6bb33cc.s: The recommendations of Lokayuktas are binding in:
n195b6bb33cc.x: Lokayukta recommendations are advisory in many States and binding only in some, not in every State.

n4d7e264a239.s: The Lokpal consists of a Chairperson and not more than ____ members.
n4d7e264a239.x: The Lokpal has a Chairperson and up to eight members, at least half of whom must be judicial members.

n7fcb40604ff.s: In which year did the First Administrative Reforms Commission recommend a two-tier Lokpal-Lokayukta system?
n7fcb40604ff.x: The First ARC made the recommendation in 1966; the Second ARC reiterated it in 2007.

o: Body created by a Constitutional Amendment
n3e01cc2ad03.x: The Lokpal is established by statute and is not a constitutional body.

n146a2fb1ea8.s: In which year did Parliament pass the Lokpal and Lokayuktas Bill?
n146a2fb1ea8.x: Parliament passed the Lokpal and Lokayuktas Bill in December 2013, after the Bill's re-introduction in 2008.

n0f55e704d9e.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about India's investigating agencies?
o: The Enforcement Directorate enforces the Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002
The Enforcement Directorate enforces the Foreign Exchange Management Act, 1999
The CBI handles only corruption cases and has no role in economic or special crimes
The Directorate of Revenue Intelligence is mainly concerned with anti-smuggling and customs evasion
n0f55e704d9e.x: Apart from corruption cases, the CBI also investigates economic and special crimes.

nc073479aa4f.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Central Bureau of Investigation?
o: It is an attached office under the Department of Personnel and Training
It was initially set up by a resolution of the Ministry of Home Affairs
It derives its powers from the Delhi Special Police Establishment Act, 1946
nc073479aa4f.x: The CBI is not a constitutional body; it was set up by an MHA resolution and draws its powers from the DSPE Act, 1946.

n3a7886d58db.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the supervisory and prosecution arrangements for the CBI?
o: The Lokpal has superintendence and direction over the CBI in cases it refers
The Director of Prosecution is appointed on the CVC's recommendation for a three-year term
The Directorate of Prosecution is headed by an officer not below the rank of Joint Secretary
The Director of Prosecution is appointed on the recommendation of the CVC
n3a7886d58db.x: The Director of Prosecution is appointed on the CVC's recommendation for a two-year term, not three years.

n303c57e4ab7.s:
Assertion (A): Under the Rules of 2019, the term of an Information Commissioner was fixed at three years.
Reason (R): The RTI (Amendment) Act, 2019 empowered the Centre to fix the tenure and salaries of CIC and SIC members.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n303c57e4ab7.x: The 2019 Amendment let the Centre fix tenure and salaries, and using that power the 2019 Rules set the term at three years, so R explains A.

n1bcb19b1ada.s: The Central Vigilance Commission, set up in 1964 by executive resolution, became a statutory body under the:
n1bcb19b1ada.x: The CVC became statutory under the CVC Act, 2003; it is the apex vigilance body but not a constitutional body.

n9a33e8dac3b.s: The BHARATPOL portal, launched in January 2025 for real-time Interpol assistance requests, was developed by the:
n9a33e8dac3b.x: BHARATPOL was developed by the CBI for central and State agencies to send Interpol assistance requests.

n5d25a7eb6ae.s: The Central Vigilance Commissioner is appointed by the:
n5d25a7eb6ae.x: The Central Vigilance Commissioner is appointed by the President, not the Prime Minister.

n4b401017db1.s: In which year was Vineet Narain v. Union of India decided?
n4b401017db1.x: Vineet Narain was decided in 1997; the DSPE Act was revised in 2003 in response to its directions.

nfdca2eb5cf9.s: In which year was the Central Bureau of Investigation set up?
nfdca2eb5cf9.x: The CBI was set up in 1963, after the Special Police Establishment (1941) and the DSPE Act (1946), and a year before the CVC (1964).

n50b857d5710.s:
Assertion (A): The Governing Council of NITI Aayog includes the Lieutenant Governors of Union Territories without legislatures.
Reason (R): The Governing Council includes only elected representatives and excludes special invitees.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n50b857d5710.x: The Governing Council includes the PM, all State CMs, CMs of UTs with legislatures and LGs of other UTs, but it also has special invitees, so R is false.

n1c3c8cf7610.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the forms of decentralisation?
o: Deconcentration shifts work to field offices of the same government
Delegation transfers powers to elected local governments with their own revenue
Delegation entrusts tasks to semi-autonomous bodies
Devolution transfers powers to elected local governments with their own mandate and revenue
n1c3c8cf7610.x: Delegation entrusts tasks to semi-autonomous bodies; transferring powers to elected local governments with their own mandate and revenue is devolution.

n79502f512e0.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the arguments advanced in India in favour of centralisation?
o: Planned heavy industry was said to need a single command
Food security was said to need a single command
Elite capture by dominant local castes was cited as a reason for decentralisation
Weak local capacity was used as an argument for centralisation
n79502f512e0.x: The risk of elite capture by locally dominant castes was cited in favour of centralisation, not decentralisation.

ne5abf1cd92d.s: Article 40, on organising village panchayats, is a:
ne5abf1cd92d.x: Article 40 is a Directive Principle in Part IV; it is non-justiciable.

nindian-polity-37-11.s: Which of the following is NOT a functional area of local government?
nindian-polity-37-11.x: Public health, sanitation and water supply are local functions; judicial review belongs to the higher courts.

n5a95dc0f0f2.s:
Assertion (A): Democratic decentralisation was a fundamental objective of Panchayati Raj.
Reason (R): Financial mobilisation was the primary constitutional objective of Panchayati Raj.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n5a95dc0f0f2.x: The fundamental objectives were people's participation in development and democratic decentralisation; financial mobilisation was not, so R is false.

nd33154db6b3.s: Rashtriya Gram Swaraj Abhiyan, which trains members of Panchayati Raj Institutions, is implemented by the:
nd33154db6b3.x: RGSA is implemented by the Ministry of Panchayati Raj from 2018-19 to train PRI members.

nbaf16d596ee.s: After the 73rd Amendment, which of the following is NOT considered necessary for effective Panchayati Raj?
o: Decentralisation of the system as a whole
nbaf16d596ee.x: The needs identified are decentralisation of decision-making, of administrative powers and of the system as a whole, not of judicial powers.

n5e020598760.s: The Hanumantha Rao Committee (1984) recommended district planning coordinated by the:
n5e020598760.x: The Hanumantha Rao Committee wanted the Collector to coordinate district planning.

n16b5a96844f.s: Which of the following pairs is wrongly matched?
o: Hanumantha Rao Committee – Collector as main coordinator of district planning
Thungon Committee – District Development Commissioner as Zila Parishad CEO
G.V.K. Rao Committee – District Development Commissioner as Zila Parishad CEO
L.M. Singhvi Committee – Constitutional status and Nyaya Panchayats for village clusters
n16b5a96844f.x: The Thungon Committee proposed the District Collector, not a District Development Commissioner, as Zila Parishad CEO.

n1ba3f3ee2ad.s: Which of the following pairs relating to Community Development is wrongly matched?
o: S.K. Dey – Built Nilokheri and served as Union Minister of Community Development
V.T. Krishnamachari – Chairman of the Grow More Food Inquiry Committee
Jawaharlal Nehru – Launched the CDP and inaugurated Panchayati Raj at Nagaur
n1ba3f3ee2ad.x: Albert Mayer was the American planner behind the Etawah Pilot Project; Nilokheri is associated with S.K. Dey.

neefc82155dc.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Balwant Rai Mehta Committee's recommendations?
o: The Zila Parishad should be the executive body
The District Collector should chair the Zila Parishad
Planning and development functions should go to Panchayati Raj bodies
The transfer of functions should come with adequate resources
neefc82155dc.x: The Committee made the Panchayat Samiti, not the Zila Parishad, the executive body.

nindian-polity-37-4.s: Which of the following pairs is wrongly matched?
o: Balwant Rai Mehta Committee – Three-tier Panchayati Raj
L.M. Singhvi Committee – Constitutional status and greater financial resources
Ashok Mehta Committee – Three-tier Panchayati Raj
Hanumantha Rao Committee – Decentralisation of powers and finance and district planning bodies
nindian-polity-37-4.x: The Ashok Mehta Committee proposed a two-tier model with separate Nyaya Panchayats; the three-tier model was Balwant Rai Mehta's.

n9102f5ea940.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Balwant Rai Mehta Committee?
o: It examined the working of the Community Development Programme
It examined the working of the Integrated Rural Development Programme
It examined the working of the National Extension Service
n9102f5ea940.x: It examined the Community Development Programme (1952) and the National Extension Service (1953); IRDP was outside its terms of reference.

n341593c41d0.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Balwant Rai Mehta Committee's recommendations?
o: Direct election to the Zila Parishad
The Panchayat Samiti as the executive body
The District Collector as chairman of the Zila Parishad
n341593c41d0.x: The Committee did not recommend direct election to the Zila Parishad; it recommended three tiers with the Panchayat Samiti as the executive body.

nc079fab7b41.s:
Assertion (A): The 64th Constitutional Amendment Bill, seeking constitutional status for Panchayats, was defeated in the Rajya Sabha in October 1989.
Reason (R): The Bill did not secure the required special majority in the Rajya Sabha.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nc079fab7b41.x: Moved by the Rajiv Gandhi Government in July 1989, the Bill was defeated in the Rajya Sabha because it failed to get the special majority, so R explains A.

n3939b7887bf.s:
Assertion (A): The G.V.K. Rao Committee treated the district as the basic unit of planning.
Reason (R): The G.V.K. Rao Committee recommended that a District Development Commissioner act as Chief Executive Officer of the Zila Parishad.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n3939b7887bf.x: Both are recommendations of the G.V.K. Rao Committee, but naming a DDC as CEO does not explain why the district was made the planning unit.

n353d37e1243.s:
Assertion (A): The National Extension Service came after the Community Development Programme.
Reason (R): The Community Development Programme was launched in 1952 and the National Extension Service in 1953.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n353d37e1243.x: CDP began in 1952 and NES in 1953, which is exactly why NES followed CDP.

n1fb0d7559ad.s: In which year was Panchayati Raj implemented in Rajasthan and Andhra Pradesh?
n1fb0d7559ad.x: After the NDC accepted the Balwant Rai Mehta model in January 1958, Rajasthan and Andhra Pradesh implemented Panchayati Raj in 1959.

nd833059e985.s: The 73rd Constitutional Amendment came into force on:
nd833059e985.x: The 73rd Amendment, which grew out of the Narasimha Rao Bill, came into force on 24 April 1993.

n04adce0240a.s: Which of the following is NOT part of the triple test laid down in Vikas Kishanrao Gawali v. State of Maharashtra (2021)?
o: A dedicated commission conducting a rigorous empirical inquiry
Automatic reservation of 50 per cent for OBCs in every local body
Fixing local-body-wise reservation based on the findings
Keeping aggregate SC, ST and OBC reservation within 50 per cent
n04adce0240a.x: The judgment provides for no automatic 50 per cent OBC reservation; the other three make up the triple test.

nb57c67a58ac.s: Which of the following is NOT a function of the State Finance Commission?
o: Distribution of net proceeds of State taxes, duties, tolls and fees between the State and local bodies
Grants-in-aid from the Consolidated Fund of the State
Appointment of the State Election Commissioner
Measures to improve the finances of Panchayats and Municipalities
nb57c67a58ac.x: The SFC recommends on fiscal distribution, grants-in-aid and local finances; appointing the State Election Commissioner is not its function.

n02374634594.s: Which of the following pairs relating to Part IX is wrongly matched?
o: Article 243M – Part IX not to apply to certain areas
Article 243N – Existing laws and Panchayats continue for a limited period
n02374634594.x: Article 243O bars court interference in electoral matters; audit is under Article 243J.

nfb6a4a4b316.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Union Finance Commission's role in local-body finance?
o: It recommends measures to augment the Consolidated Fund of a State
Its local-body recommendations draw on those of the State Finance Commission
Central tax devolution is paid directly to Panchayats rather than to the States
Panchayats receive Central assistance through Finance Commission grants
nfb6a4a4b316.x: Central tax devolution goes to the States; Panchayats get Central assistance through Finance Commission grants.

nffe68f7eaa8.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Gram Sabha in Fifth Schedule areas under PESA, 1996?
o: It has only an advisory role, with village markets and liquor under the State Excise Department
It is regarded as supreme and may settle disputes in the customary way
It approves plans and identifies beneficiaries
It controls village markets and liquor
nffe68f7eaa8.x: Under PESA the Gram Sabha is not merely advisory; it controls village markets and liquor.

n76113d149ba.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about membership of Panchayats?
o: All members at the three levels are directly elected from territorial constituencies
The Constitution prescribes a uniform method for choosing every village chairperson
Intermediate and district chairpersons are elected by and from among the elected members
The method of choosing the village chairperson is left to State law
n76113d149ba.x: The Constitution leaves the method of choosing a village chairperson to State law; it prescribes no uniform method.

nba12ef5c29e.shape: one-liner (sequence not possible: the facts carry no dates)
o: Only the elected Panchayat members and the Sarpanch
Persons registered in the electoral rolls of villages within the Panchayat area
Members of the Panchayat Samiti from the village
Persons nominated by the State Election Commission
nba12ef5c29e.x: The Gram Sabha comprises persons on the village electoral rolls of the Panchayat area; its powers are left to State law.

n0d9e1023bea.s: In which State does reservation of SC seats in Panchayats not apply, because the State has no Scheduled Caste population?
n0d9e1023bea.x: Arunachal Pradesh has no SC population, so SC reservation does not apply there, though the rest of Part IX does.

ncbd857434eb.s: Which Article of Part IX provides for the State Election Commission?
ncbd857434eb.x: Article 243K provides for the SEC; 243A covers the Gram Sabha, 243B the three tiers and 243I the State Finance Commission.

n68f8fa1c787.s: The People's Plan Campaign 'Sabki Yojana Sabka Vikas' has been run since:
n68f8fa1c787.x: The campaign has run since 2 October 2018, preparing Gram Panchayat Development Plans through Gram Sabhas.

nc9faf1f31b9.s: Which of the following is a subject in the Eleventh Schedule?
nc9faf1f31b9.x: The public distribution system is an Eleventh Schedule subject; slaughterhouses, burial grounds and urban planning are Twelfth Schedule subjects.

n1f2f53e9d71.s: Under Article 243M, Part IX of the Constitution does NOT apply to which of the following States?
n1f2f53e9d71.x: Part IX does not apply to Nagaland, Meghalaya and Mizoram, the Fifth and Sixth Schedule areas, or the hill areas of Manipur that have District Councils.

n8f8ed0ecd26.s: PESA, 1996 extends Part IX of the Constitution, with exceptions, to:
n8f8ed0ecd26.x: PESA applies only to Fifth Schedule Areas, recognising governance through customary law; it does not apply to Sixth Schedule areas.

n9df4bf1d4ce.s: Which of the following is NOT an Eleventh Schedule subject?
n9df4bf1d4ce.x: Land improvement, minor irrigation and fisheries are Eleventh Schedule subjects; public order is not.

nbb7fe632558.s: The National Panchayat Awards use which index in their assessment?
nbb7fe632558.x: The awards, including the theme-wise Deen Dayal Upadhyay Panchayat Satat Vikas Puraskar, are assessed using the Panchayat Advancement Index.

n3551c35d9a3.s: Urban planning is a subject listed in which Schedule of the Constitution?
n3551c35d9a3.x: Urban planning is a Twelfth Schedule subject; fuel and fodder, rural roads and non-conventional energy are in the Eleventh.

nb36e82ebb2f.s: How many subjects are listed in the Eleventh Schedule?
nb36e82ebb2f.x: The Eleventh Schedule lists 29 subjects that the State may devolve to Panchayats; it does not transfer them automatically.

n86104896dc8.s: The State Finance Commission is constituted every five years by the:
n86104896dc8.x: The Governor constitutes the SFC every five years to review local-body finances; its recommendations are advisory.

nindian-polity-26-5.s: Which of the following is NOT a function of the Finance Commission?
o: Recommending the distribution of divisible Union taxes between the Centre and States
Recommending the allocation of the States' share among the States
Recommending principles for grants-in-aid out of the Consolidated Fund of India
Resolving Centre-State legal disputes under Article 131
nindian-polity-26-5.x: Article 131 disputes go to the Supreme Court; the other three are Finance Commission functions.

n4cfcae4341e.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about municipal tenure and elections?
o: A municipality has a five-year term
An election must be held within one year of the dissolution of a municipality
The State Election Commission conducts municipal elections
The State Finance Commission reviews the financial position of municipalities
n4cfcae4341e.x: An election must be held within six months of dissolution, not one year.

n43991a4f947.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the composition of a Metropolitan Planning Committee?
o: Not less than two-thirds of its members are elected
Elected members are chosen from municipal members and panchayat chairpersons in the area
Elected representation is in proportion to the geographical area of urban and rural parts
Elected representation reflects the ratio of urban and rural population
n43991a4f947.x: Elected representation in the MPC follows the urban-rural population ratio, not area.

nindian-polity-37-6.s: Which of the following pairs is wrongly matched?
nindian-polity-37-6.x: The 73rd Amendment came into force on 24 April 1993; 1 June 1993 is the date for the 74th.

n63669e6c348.shape: one-liner (NOT could not be built honestly: only two other confirmed facts)
n63669e6c348.s: Cantonment Boards come under which Union Ministry?
o: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
n63669e6c348.x: Cantonment Boards are under the Ministry of Defence; MoHUA is the main ministry for ULBs, and Home Affairs handles ULBs in UTs.

nbb46df591b4.s: Under Article 243ZA, municipal elections are conducted by the:
nbb46df591b4.x: Under Article 243ZA, municipal elections are conducted by the State Election Commission, not the Election Commission of India.

n84826614a12.s: The Bill introduced in September 1991 that became the 74th Constitutional Amendment was introduced by the government of:
n84826614a12.x: P.V. Narasimha Rao's Bill of September 1991 became the 74th Amendment and inserted Part IXA; the 1989 Municipalities Bill had lapsed.

n440070414e8.s: Which Article of the Constitution provides for Ward Committees?
n440070414e8.x: Article 243S provides for Ward Committees; 243Q covers types of municipalities, 243R their composition and 243T reservation.

nc6dd2f90293.s: Which of the following is NOT a Twelfth Schedule subject?
o: Street lighting, parking, bus stops and public conveniences
nc6dd2f90293.x: Technical and vocational education is an Eleventh Schedule subject; the other three are Twelfth Schedule municipal subjects.

nindian-polity-37-40.s: Which Article provides for the Metropolitan Planning Committee?
nindian-polity-37-40.x: Article 243ZE provides for the MPC; 243W covers municipal powers, 243Y the Finance Commission and 243Z audit.

nefd9bf81497.s: Local Government is a subject in which List of the Seventh Schedule?
nefd9bf81497.x: Local Government remains in the State List; the 74th Amendment did not move it to the Union List.

nc8d4b1cc92e.s: A Metropolitan Planning Committee is constituted for every metropolitan area with a population of:
nc8d4b1cc92e.x: An MPC is mandatory for every metropolitan area of ten lakh or more under Article 243ZE, and such an area may span more than one district.

n6a067ce6884.s: The Constitution (Seventy-Fourth Amendment) Act, 1992 inserted which Schedule?
n6a067ce6884.x: The 74th Amendment inserted Part IXA (Articles 243P-243ZG) and the Twelfth Schedule; the Eleventh Schedule came with the 73rd.

o: Elected head of a Gram Panchayat
Elected head of a Municipal Corporation
State-appointed chief executive of a Municipal Corporation
ndb7302dbf47.x: The Municipal Commissioner is the State-appointed chief executive of a Municipal Corporation; the Mayor heads the Corporation and the Sarpanch the Gram Panchayat.

nf89f55a26d0.s: Critics of urban governance have described Urban Local Bodies as the ____ of federalism.
nf89f55a26d0.x: ULBs, which spend less than 1 per cent of GDP and employ about 10 per cent of the public workforce, have been called the 'stepchild' of federalism.

nindian-polity-37-33.s: Which Article of the Constitution deals with the tenure and dissolution of Panchayats?
nindian-polity-37-33.x: Article 243E covers tenure; 243D covers reservations, 243G powers and 243-I the State Finance Commission.

nindian-polity-37-8.s: Which body governs an area in transition from rural to urban?
nindian-polity-37-8.x: A Nagar Panchayat governs a transitional area; the Gram Panchayat, Panchayat Samiti and Zila Parishad work at village, block and district level.

nindian-polity-37-24.s: How many functional subjects are listed in the Twelfth Schedule?
nindian-polity-37-24.x: The Twelfth Schedule lists 18 subjects for municipalities; the Eleventh lists 29 for Panchayats.

nc2315d26eb5.s: The Constitution requires not less than ____ of the members of a District Planning Committee to be elected.
nc2315d26eb5.x: At least four-fifths of DPC members must be elected; the rest are decided by State law, so the DPC is not wholly elected.

nindian-polity-49-17.s: Which of the following pairs relating to tribal areas is wrongly matched?
o: Autonomous District Councils – Sixth Schedule bodies with legislative, executive and judicial powers
Paragraph 5 of the Fifth Schedule – Governor's power to restrict tribal land transfer and money-lending
Tribes Advisory Council – Sixth Schedule body with legislative, executive and judicial powers
Samatha v. State of Andhra Pradesh (1997) – Lease of tribal land to private miners held void
nindian-polity-49-17.x: The Tribes Advisory Council is the mandatory advisory body in Fifth Schedule States, not a Sixth Schedule body with law-making powers.

n29ef15a8aa5.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the application of laws to Sixth Schedule areas?
o: Acts of Parliament and State Legislatures apply only with the prescribed direction or modification
In Meghalaya, the direction is given by the President
In Assam, the direction is given by the President
In Tripura and Mizoram, the direction is given by the President
n29ef15a8aa5.x: In Assam the direction is given by the Governor; in Meghalaya, Tripura and Mizoram it is given by the President.

n9f4e5966cb9.s: Which of the following is correct about the implementation of PESA?
o: Gram Sabha consent is always obtained before land acquisition in PESA areas
Provisions on minor minerals and minor forest produce are among the least implemented
Provisions on minor forest produce are the most fully implemented
Consultation is accepted as fully protecting tribal decision-making
n9f4e5966cb9.x: Minor minerals and minor forest produce provisions are among the least implemented; Gram Sabha consent has reportedly been ignored in some land acquisitions.

na487b3e453d.s: Which of the following is NOT a criterion for declaring an area a Scheduled Area?
o: Compactness and reasonable size of the area
na487b3e453d.x: The criteria are tribal preponderance, compactness and reasonable size, a viable administrative unit and economic backwardness; industrial development is not one.

n7a028135582.s: The Governor reports to the President on the administration of Scheduled Areas:
o: Annually or whenever the President requires
Only when the State Legislature requests
n7a028135582.x: The Governor reports annually or whenever required; the Union may also give the State directions on administering Scheduled Areas.

nd73bb269040.s: Under PESA, Scheduled Tribes must get at least what share of Panchayat seats in Scheduled Areas?
nd73bb269040.x: Seats are reserved in proportion to population, with STs getting at least 50%; all Chairperson posts at every level go to STs.

nca53eb183a6.s: Regulations for the peace and good government of a Scheduled Area under Paragraph 5 of the Fifth Schedule are made by the:
nca53eb183a6.x: The Governor makes these regulations after consulting the Tribes Advisory Council, and they need the President's assent.

nabb2ca3b08d.s: Under the Sixth Schedule, every autonomous region within an autonomous district has a:
nabb2ca3b08d.x: The Governor may divide an autonomous district into autonomous regions, each with a Regional Council; the region lies within the district.

n373451c1824.s: The Tribes Advisory Council shall have not more than ____ members.
n373451c1824.x: The TAC has not more than 20 members, about three-fourths of them ST members of the State Legislative Assembly.

n7b0c4798756.s: In which year were the Andhra Pradesh PESA Rules issued?
n7b0c4798756.x: The AP PESA Rules came in 2011; AP's amending Act dates to 1998.

nb7a667bd10a.s: Which of the following is a Scheduled Tribe-reserved Lok Sabha constituency in Andhra Pradesh?
nb7a667bd10a.x: Araku is an ST Lok Sabha seat; AP is one of the ten Fifth Schedule States, with Scheduled Areas in the old Agency tracts.

n32965bcdaa1.s: Which of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
o: Sixth Schedule – District and Regional Councils
n32965bcdaa1.x: PESA applies to Fifth Schedule areas, not to areas governed by the Sixth Schedule.

n2dfdfd5f302.s: Which Act recognises individual and community rights over forest land and ownership rights over minor forest produce?
n2dfdfd5f302.x: The Forest Rights Act, 2006 recognises individual and community forest rights and ownership of minor forest produce.

n8f951b10cc6.s: In Scheduled Areas, the Zila Panchayat may perform which of the following functions?
o: Planning for minor water bodies only
Planning for minor water bodies, control of social-sector institutions and control of Tribal Sub-Plans
n8f951b10cc6.x: The Zila Panchayat in Scheduled Areas may do all three, along with other functions the State confers.

n07f9d36a167.s: The Sixth Schedule applies to the tribal areas of which States?
o: Meghalaya, Tripura, Mizoram and Arunachal Pradesh
n07f9d36a167.x: The Sixth Schedule covers tribal areas of Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura and Mizoram; Nagaland has its own provisions under Article 371A.

n27dd3a42c99.s: In a PESA area, a Gram Sabha meeting is presided over by:
o: An ST member elected by the Gram Sabha
n27dd3a42c99.x: The presiding officer is an ST member elected by the Gram Sabha; the Sarpanch does not automatically preside.

n601f076e617.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the AP Cabinet decision of 18 August 2026 on electing local body heads?
o: Until now, Mayors have been elected indirectly from among the corporators
It approved direct election of Mayors of Municipal Corporations
It approved direct election of Chairpersons of Municipalities and Nagar Panchayats
It also provided for direct election of Mandal Parishad Presidents
n601f076e617.x: The decision covered urban heads only; Mandal Parishad Presidents remain indirectly elected.

nc9f0b386d80.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Thungon Committee recommendations?
o: A maximum one-year period for supersession of Panchayats
Constitutional status for Panchayati Raj Institutions
Zilla Parishad as the pivot of planning
A State Finance Commission in each State
nc9f0b386d80.x: The Thungon Committee recommended a maximum supersession period of six months, not one year.

n90f54c5eb04.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the State Finance Commission?
o: It is constituted every five years
It reviews the finances of Panchayats and Municipalities
It is constituted by the State Election Commission
It recommends the sharing of taxes, duties, tolls, fees and grants
n90f54c5eb04.x: The State Finance Commission is constituted by the Governor.

ne2ff5affd0c.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the recent reorganisation of Panchayati Raj institutions in Andhra Pradesh?
o: The terms of the Mandal Praja Parishads end on 23 September 2026
The erstwhile 13 Zilla Praja Parishads have been reorganised into 26
The terms of the Zilla Praja Parishads end on 24 September 2026
The number of Zilla Praja Parishads now stands at 28
ne2ff5affd0c.x: The former 13 Zilla Praja Parishads have been reorganised into 28, not 26.

ncd5784f2127.s:
Assertion (A): The 33.33 per cent reservation for Backward Classes in AP urban local bodies is implemented under the AP Municipal Corporations Act, 1994.
Reason (R): The 33.33 per cent BC reservation in urban local bodies is provided exclusively under the Panchayat Raj Act, 1994.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
ncd5784f2127.x: The BC quota is implemented under the AP Municipal Corporations Act, 1994 and the AP Municipalities Act, 1965, not exclusively under the Panchayat Raj Act.

n5d34a45e59d.s: Under the AP Panchayat Raj Act, 1994, the minimum age for contesting a Gram Panchayat election is:
n5d34a45e59d.x: The minimum contesting age is 21; ward members and the Sarpanch are directly elected for five years.

n59f43e24b9c.s: Under the Atmanirbhar Panchayat Program, a Gram Panchayat must have own-source revenue of at least:
n59f43e24b9c.x: The threshold is Rs 50 lakh for a Gram Panchayat and Rs 1 crore for a Block Panchayat, with three years' tenure left and written Gram Sabha consent.

n48c6102a560.s: The State Election Commissioner can be removed only in the manner and on the grounds applicable to a:
o: Member of a State Public Service Commission
n48c6102a560.x: Removal follows the procedure for a High Court judge; the Governor cannot remove the Commissioner at will.

n9a483a70f3f.s: Under Article 243Q, which factors does the Governor take into account when classifying areas as municipal bodies?
o: Population, density and revenue for local administration only
Revenue and percentage of non-agricultural employment only
Population, density, revenue for local administration and percentage of non-agricultural employment
n9a483a70f3f.x: All four factors (population, density, revenue for local administration and non-agricultural employment) are considered.

nbda846b8cd5.s: Part IX-A, inserted by the 74th Constitutional Amendment, comprises Articles:
nbda846b8cd5.x: Part IX-A on municipalities runs from Article 243P to 243ZG and is linked to the 18 Twelfth Schedule subjects.

n6facba042ec.s: The Balwant Rai Mehta Committee envisaged which body as the executive body of Panchayati Raj?
n6facba042ec.x: The Panchayat Samiti was to be executive and the Zilla Parishad advisory, with the Collector as its Chairman; the two-tier model was Ashok Mehta's.

n1f68508ae54.s: On which date did Andhra Pradesh introduce Panchayati Raj?
n1f68508ae54.x: AP introduced Panchayati Raj on 1 November 1959 following the Balwant Rai Mehta Committee; Rajasthan was first and AP second.

na7463df7037.shape: one-liner (sequence not possible: the facts carry no dates)
na7463df7037.s: Which of the following is NOT a function of the State Election Commission?
o: Controlling electoral rolls for Panchayat elections
Directing rearrangement and republication of Gram Panchayat electoral rolls
na7463df7037.x: The SEC controls Panchayat electoral rolls and conducts municipal elections, but it does not conduct cooperative elections.

na48e9c318b5.shape: one-liner (sequence kept as a single ordering question; no dates)
na48e9c318b5.s: The correct order of municipal grades under the Andhra Pradesh Municipalities Act is:
o: Special, Grade I, Selection, Grade II, Grade III
Grade I, Grade II, Grade III, Selection, Special
Special, Selection, Grade I, Grade II, Grade III
Selection, Special, Grade II, Grade I, Grade III
na48e9c318b5.x: The grades are Special, Selection, Grade I, Grade II and Grade III.

nbdbeae93efd.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the public policy cycle?
o: Agenda setting brings an identified problem onto the policy agenda
Communication and transparency are confined to the evaluation stage
Media, advocacy and expert analysis can place an issue on the agenda
Monitoring and evaluation give feedback that may lead to policy adjustment
nbdbeae93efd.x: Communication and transparency run through every stage of the cycle, not just evaluation.

nf1d132e9142.s:
Assertion (A): Social defence involves rehabilitation in deviant or vulnerable situations.
Reason (R): Social justice aims at the removal of social and economic inequalities.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
nf1d132e9142.x: Both describe social-sector concepts correctly, but the aim of social justice does not explain what social defence is.

n8d946a0cda2.s: Which type of public policy creates or reorganises institutions?
n8d946a0cda2.x: Constitutive policy creates or reorganises institutions; regulatory policy limits individual or firm behaviour.

nba4859d7e26.s: Judicial interpretation as a basis of Indian public policy is illustrated by the Right to Food under Article:
nba4859d7e26.x: Courts read the Right to Food into Article 21, which makes judicial interpretation one of the bases of public policy.

n7cac45667cd.s: Who defined public policy as the 'authoritative allocation of values for the whole society'?
n7cac45667cd.x: Easton gave this definition; Lasswell called policy a projected programme of goals, values and practices.

nindian-society-7-16.s: The welfare of senior citizens comes under which Union Ministry?
o: Ministry of Women and Child Development
Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
nindian-society-7-16.x: Senior citizens are under Social Justice and Empowerment; Tribal Affairs handles the FRA and WCD the Poshan schemes.

nindian-society-7-2.s: Matters relating to the Parsi community come under which Union Ministry?
o: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
Ministry of Women and Child Development
nindian-society-7-2.x: Minority Affairs handles the Parsis and other minorities; Social Justice handles transgender welfare.

n55bbbe92b39.s: The optimal model of policy-making is associated with:
n55bbbe92b39.x: Dror proposed the optimal model; Easton is linked to the systems model, Bentley to group theory and Mills to elite theory.

n2cbb3fc828d.s: The Development Monitoring and Evaluation Office (DMEO) is the apex monitoring and evaluation office under:
o: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
n2cbb3fc828d.x: DMEO works under NITI Aayog, evaluating Central schemes suo motu or at a ministry's request and advising States.

n27e2689ffc8.s: Social legislation that creates entitlements is called:
n27e2689ffc8.x: Enabling legislation creates entitlements; protective legislation guards against exploitation and regulatory legislation governs conduct.

n123fafc80c6.s: Proactive disclosure under Section 4 of the RTI Act illustrates which policy instrument?
n123fafc80c6.x: Section 4 proactive disclosure is an information instrument; regulation uses licensing and standards, and direct provision means services like schools and PHCs.

nindian-society-7-1.s: In which year was the Ministry of Welfare renamed the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment?
nindian-society-7-1.x: The Ministry of Welfare (1985) was renamed in 1998; Tribal Affairs split off in 1999 and Minority Affairs in 2006.

n195b6bd73f9.s: In which Five-Year Plan did India's approach to women shift from welfare to development?
n195b6bd73f9.x: The welfare-to-development shift came in the Sixth Plan; the empowerment approach marked the Eighth and Ninth Plans.

n2b1b9742470.s: In the public policy cycle, which stage immediately follows formulation?
n2b1b9742470.x: The sequence is agenda-setting, formulation, adoption, implementation and evaluation.

n3c109ff5c56.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the options available against a Supreme Court decision?
o: A Presidential reference under Article 143 produces a binding judgment on the dispute
Parliament may amend the law to remove the basis of a judgment but cannot simply overrule it
A constitutional amendment under Article 368 must respect the basic structure
A review or curative petition is heard by the same Court
n3c109ff5c56.x: A Presidential reference under Article 143 yields only an advisory opinion, not a binding judgment.

n8f05e6dcf8c.s:
Assertion (A): The Press Information Bureau handles press briefings, accreditation of journalists and social-media communication.
Reason (R): The PM's Communication Wing handles publicity for the PMO and the Cabinet and gives daily newspaper feedback.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n8f05e6dcf8c.x: Both are true, but they describe two separate bodies; the PM's Communication Wing's role does not explain the PIB's functions.

n30dfdd18ee6.s: Pressure groups, trade unions and NGOs belong to which set of governance stakeholders?
n30dfdd18ee6.x: State, Market and Civil Society are the three broad stakeholder sets, and pressure groups, trade unions and NGOs belong to civil society.

n594442f56c4.s: NITI Aayog is chaired by the:
n594442f56c4.x: The Prime Minister chairs NITI Aayog, a non-constitutional, non-statutory policy think tank working on cooperative federalism.

n79e8af2247d.s: In which year was the National Innovation Council established as a Government body?
n79e8af2247d.x: The National Innovation Council was set up in 2010; CPR, NCAER, PRS and ORF are independent bodies.

n31d8b15909b.s: Which of the following is correct about the image-building role of mass media?
o: Media treatment has no bearing on the public image of political personalities
Mass media play no part in shaping the identity of political personalities
The ideology of a media outlet can influence its treatment of news
A media outlet's ideology is irrelevant to how it treats news
n31d8b15909b.x: Mass media shape the image of political personalities, and an outlet's ideology can colour its treatment of news.

nf2543943f80.s: In which year did Public Interest Litigation begin in India, with a case filed on behalf of prisoners?
nf2543943f80.x: PIL began in 1979 with a case filed on behalf of prisoners; its basis lies in Articles 32, 226 and 142.

n4de31fc91e5.s: Which of the following is NOT identified as a concern relating to bureaucracy?
n4de31fc91e5.x: Frontline implementation discretion is itself a concern, so 'complete absence of discretion' is not.

n087996820eb.s: From which date has Andhra Pradesh published Action Taken Reports on its seven sectoral white papers?
n087996820eb.x: AP has published Action Taken Reports from 22 June 2026, so manifesto delivery can be tracked publicly.

n49f4b48df83.s: The MKSS right-to-information movement led to which law?
n49f4b48df83.x: The MKSS movement led to the RTI Act, 2005; Right to Work advocacy to MGNREGA and the Right to Food campaign to the NFSA.

n003125c25cb.s:
Assertion (A): The World Bank stresses accountability, transparency and the rule of law in its approach to governance.
Reason (R): UNESCAP stresses efficiency, effectiveness, equity and sustainability in governance.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n003125c25cb.x: Both describe different agencies' approaches correctly, but UNESCAP's emphasis does not explain the World Bank's.

na39928dabd4.s: The Good Governance Index is published by:
na39928dabd4.x: DARPG publishes the Good Governance Index; NITI Aayog publishes the SDG India Index, DPIIT the BRAP rankings and PAC the Public Affairs Index.

n08de0ec5a3a.s: The Second ARC's 12th Report, which covered Citizen's Charters, grievance redress and the Sevottam model, was titled:
o: Promoting e-Governance – The SMART Way Forward
Citizen Centric Administration – The Heart of Governance
n08de0ec5a3a.x: The 12th Report (2009), 'Citizen Centric Administration – The Heart of Governance', covered Citizen's Charters, grievance redress, Sevottam and people's participation.

n27ec7848d7a.s: The Centre for Good Governance, set up by undivided Andhra Pradesh in 2001, is based in:
n27ec7848d7a.x: The CGG, set up with DFID (UK) and the World Bank, is in Hyderabad; New Delhi and Mussoorie are the locations of the National Centre for Good Governance.

n89e5cae414a.s: Among the pillars of good governance, 'Ethos' stands for:
n89e5cae414a.x: Ethos means service; ethics means honesty and integrity, equity means empathy for weaker sections, and efficiency means speedy ICT-based delivery.

n6ef8d1f4a6e.s: The Good Governance Index of DARPG, launched on Good Governance Day 2019, is to be revised every:
n6ef8d1f4a6e.x: The GGI, which ranks States, UTs and districts, is to be revised every two years.

n51449f090f3.s: The Worldwide Governance Indicators have been available since:
n51449f090f3.x: The WGI cover more than 200 countries since 1996, with dimensions including Government Effectiveness and Rule of Law.

nb5558ffbeef.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about types of e-governance interaction?
o: G2G refers to interaction between departments or governments
NIC solutions, SWAN and e-Office are G2G examples
G2E refers to interaction between different governments
Online HR and administrative tools are G2E examples
nb5558ffbeef.x: G2E means services from government to its employees; interaction between governments is G2G.

n9ae5f3b0b6d.s: Which of the following pairs relating to Halachmi's model of e-governance is wrongly matched?
o: Comparative analysis – Learning from best practices elsewhere
E-advocacy – Online civil-society networks influencing decisions
Interactive service – Two-way G2C services such as filing, payments and feedback
E-advocacy – Learning from best practices elsewhere
n9ae5f3b0b6d.x: Learning from best practices is comparative analysis; e-advocacy means online civil-society networks influencing decisions.

n3b6d3b13e55.s:
Assertion (A): The Emergency Response Support System (ERSS) is linked to the single emergency number 112.
Reason (R): Common Service Centres (CSCs) are village-level service outlets.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n3b6d3b13e55.x: Both statements are true, but CSCs as village outlets have nothing to do with ERSS's link to 112.

nf8a69864076.s: In which year were the National Awards for e-Governance (NAeG) started?
nf8a69864076.x: NAeG, instituted by DARPG, began in 2003 and are presented at the National Conference on e-Governance.

n9759ee3b4be.s: Andhra Pradesh's Real Time Governance Society (RTGS) was established in:
n9759ee3b4be.x: RTGS, AP's flagship digital-governance platform using a Data Lake and real-time dashboards, was set up in 2017.

nd7e4b6c7ee9.s: Which single application gives access to Central and State Government services such as tax, EPF, gas and passport services through web, SMS and IVR?
nd7e4b6c7ee9.x: UMANG offers multiple Central and State services through web, SMS and IVR.

n53ae62c35ae.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the First Administrative Reforms Commission?
o: Morarji Desai was associated with it
It recommended a Lokpal in each State and Lokayuktas at the Union level
It recommended a Lokpal at the Union level
n53ae62c35ae.x: It recommended a Lokpal for the Union and Lokayuktas for the States, not the other way round.

n36913532cf5.s: Which of the following pairs (mechanism – primary character) is wrongly matched?
o: CPGRAMS and State portals – Independent officer of the legislature
CPGRAMS and State portals – Service-delivery grievances
Lokpal and Lokayukta – Corruption allegations against public functionaries
Classic Ombudsman – Independent officer of the legislature
n36913532cf5.x: CPGRAMS and State portals handle service-delivery grievances; the independent officer of the legislature is the classic Ombudsman.

n0aaac161576.s:
Assertion (A): The Second Administrative Reforms Commission recommended statutory status for Citizens' Charters.
Reason (R): Citizens' Charters in India are legally enforceable rights in their present form.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n0aaac161576.x: The Second ARC did recommend statutory status, but Indian Citizens' Charters are generally non-justiciable and not presently enforceable, so R is false.

nf3ba875d90f.s: Which of the following is NOT one of the six principles of the Citizens' Charter?
nf3ba875d90f.x: The six principles are quality, choice, standards, value, accountability and transparency; participation is not one. The Charter began in the UK in 1991 under John Major.

n07d3afc1777.s: Under Section 17 of MGNREGA, 2005, social audit of all works is conducted by the:
n07d3afc1777.x: Section 17 makes the Gram Sabha audit all works; social audit is MGNREGA's accountability tool, not a CVC function.

nfc8f35044a6.s: India adopted the Citizens' Charter in:
nfc8f35044a6.x: India adopted it in 1997; 1991 is its UK origin. DARPG coordinates the charters (goicharters.nic.in).

nc61a327d321.s: Which State enacted India's first Right to Services law?
nc61a327d321.x: Madhya Pradesh's Lok Sewa Guarantee Act, 2010 was the first; Bihar followed in 2011.

n5b5fd1e982e.s: Which of the following is NOT a dimension of the Grievance Redressal Assessment & Index (GRAI)?
n5b5fd1e982e.x: GRAI's four dimensions (11 indicators) are efficiency, feedback, domain and organisational commitment; transparency is not one.

n0edaf62b480.s: Implementation of the Sevottam model in government departments began in:
n0edaf62b480.x: Sevottam, suggested in the Second ARC's 12th Report and promoted by DARPG, was implemented from 2009; 2005 is when the Second ARC was set up.

n8cf7c48490a.s: The AP Society for Social Audit, Accountability and Transparency (SSAAT) was set up in:
n8cf7c48490a.x: SSAAT, an independent society, was set up in 2009; 2005 is the year of MGNREGA. AP pioneered state-wide MGNREGA social audits.

n429112fec7f.s: What happened to the Citizens Charter Bill, 2011, on time-bound delivery of services and grievance redress?
o: It lapsed with the dissolution of the Lok Sabha in 2014
It was withdrawn by the Government in 2012
n429112fec7f.x: The Bill never became law; it lapsed when the Lok Sabha was dissolved in 2014.

n9b160ba431c.s: Among the following States, which enacted its Right to Services law earliest?
n9b160ba431c.x: The order of enactment among these is Punjab, Assam, Gujarat and Maharashtra.

n9c0fdfc4cb4.s: Which of the following pairs (RTI-related case – decision) is wrongly matched?
o: CBSE v. Aditya Bandopadhyay – Evaluated answer sheets are information accessible to examinees
Zee Telefilms v. Union of India – Office of the CJI is a public authority under the RTI Act
Girish Ramchandra Deshpande v. CIC – Service records and tax returns of a public servant are personal information
CPIO, Supreme Court v. Subhash Chandra Agarwal – Office of the CJI is a public authority under the RTI Act
n9c0fdfc4cb4.x: Zee Telefilms held that the BCCI is not 'State' under Article 12; the CJI's office ruling came in Subhash Chandra Agarwal.

n4f4802dbc0c.s: Which Section of the RTI Act, 2005 provides for the constitution of the Central Information Commission?
n4f4802dbc0c.x: Section 12 constitutes the CIC; Section 15 the SIC, Section 5 covers PIOs and Section 9 copyright-based rejection.

ne2b3dc57d96.s: In CBSE v. Aditya Bandopadhyay (2011), the Supreme Court held that evaluated answer sheets are:
o: Held in a fiduciary capacity and hence exempt
Accessible only through a court order
ne2b3dc57d96.x: Evaluated answer sheets are information that examinees can inspect, and the examining body does not hold them in a fiduciary capacity.

n7c12805222e.s: When did the Supreme Court refer the challenge to the DPDP amendment of the RTI Act to a Constitution Bench?
n7c12805222e.x: The amendment was notified in November 2025 and the challenge was referred to a Constitution Bench in February 2026; on 7 August 2026 the Court agreed to examine repugnancy.

n5198e49e8a2.s: The right to know has been judicially read into which Article of the Constitution?
n5198e49e8a2.x: Courts have read the right to know into Article 19(1)(a), and also Article 21, in cases like State of U.P. v. Raj Narain and S.P. Gupta.

n2a4feafc279.s: Which of the following cannot be appointed a State Information Commissioner?
o: A person of eminence in public life with knowledge of law
A person of eminence in public life with knowledge of journalism
A person of eminence in public life with knowledge of administration
n2a4feafc279.x: A sitting MP cannot be appointed; the appointee must be eminent in public life and hold no office of profit.

nacf8ba41b3e.s: Under Section 8(3) of the RTI Act, most exempt information becomes disclosable after:
nacf8ba41b3e.x: The Section 8(3) rule is 20 years, with exceptions such as cabinet deliberations; Section 8(2) is the public-interest override.

nf8f5d75fcf3.s: Sweden's Freedom of the Press Act, regarded as the world's first freedom-of-information law, dates to:
nf8f5d75fcf3.x: Sweden's 1766 Freedom of the Press Act was the first such law; UDHR Article 19 (1948) later recognised the right to seek information.

ncaaafb9290d.s: Under the RTI Act, a second appeal to the Central or State Information Commission is ordinarily filed within:
ncaaafb9290d.x: The second appeal lies within ninety days; the first appeal is filed within thirty days.

nf89b7c6a883.s: The CIC has ruled that which of the following is NOT a public authority under Section 2(h) of the RTI Act?
o: Office of the Chief Justice of India
An NGO substantially financed by Government
nf89b7c6a883.x: The CIC ruled that the BCCI is not a public authority under Section 2(h); the CJI's office and substantially financed NGOs are.

n059100a39ea.s: Before the 2019 amendment, the salary of a State Information Commissioner was linked to that of the:
o: Chief Justice of the High Court
n059100a39ea.x: A State IC's salary was linked to the Chief Secretary's, while the CIC's equalled the Chief Election Commissioner's.

n9be1bc6e645.s: Under the original RTI Act, the term of an Information Commissioner was:
o: Three years or until the age of 65
Five years or until the age of 62
Six years or until the age of 65
Five years or until the age of 65
n9be1bc6e645.x: The original term was five years or age 65, with no reappointment; since 2019 the Centre notifies it, and the 2019 Rules fix three years.

n28fda1b62ce.s: How many political parties were declared public authorities by the CIC under the RTI Act?
n28fda1b62ce.x: The CIC declared six parties public authorities; they did not comply, and the 2005 Act does not name political parties.

n7b79d0d82a2.s: The demand to bring political parties under the RTI Act is intended to:
o: Check corruption and crony capitalism and scrutinise illegal foreign contributions
n7b79d0d82a2.x: Activists cite checking corruption and crony capitalism, scrutiny of illegal foreign contributions and parties' state privileges such as free Doordarshan airtime.

ne8e73f73335.s: Section 11 of the RTI Act, 2005 deals with:
o: Constitution of the State Information Commission
ne8e73f73335.x: Section 11 covers third-party information; Section 19 covers appeals and Section 15 the SIC.

nf60b1fd8d82.s: In penalty proceedings under Section 20 of the RTI Act, the burden of proof lies on the:
nf60b1fd8d82.x: The PIO bears the burden of proof and must be heard before a penalty; the Commission may also recommend disciplinary action.

n91b889ab49f.s: Members of the Central Vigilance Commission hold office for:
o: 4 years or until the age of 65
5 years or until the age of 65
3 years or until the age of 65
6 years or until the age of 65
n91b889ab49f.x: The CVC term is 4 years or age 65; 5 years or 65 was the original Information Commission term.

n5824edc4bd7.s: Under Section 2(h) of the RTI Act, public authorities include:
o: Only bodies created directly by the Constitution
Only bodies established by an Act of Parliament
Bodies set up by law or government notification, and bodies substantially financed or controlled by government
n5824edc4bd7.x: Section 2(h) covers bodies set up by law or notification and those substantially financed or controlled by government, not just constitutional bodies.

n8c74b5521d4.s: The Second ARC recommended that the Section 8 exemptions of the RTI Act be interpreted:
n8c74b5521d4.x: The Second ARC wanted Section 8 exemptions read narrowly and maximum information placed in the public domain automatically.

n8ac107a5fd8.s: Under Section 6(2) of the RTI Act, an applicant seeking information:
o: Must state the reasons for seeking it
Need not give any reason for seeking it
n8ac107a5fd8.x: No reasons are needed; applications may be made by post, in person or by e-mail, in Hindi, English or the local official language.

n39e5d403aa8.s: Under the RTI Act, information concerning the life or liberty of a person must be supplied within:
n39e5d403aa8.x: Life or liberty cases must be answered within 48 hours; routing through an APIO gives 35 days and third-party cases 40 days.

n95c1d68895a.s: The Central and State Information Commissions are:
