o: Statutory bodies under the RTI Act
Bodies under the Protection of Human Rights Act
n95c1d68895a.x: Both are statutory bodies under the RTI Act, with civil-court powers, hearing second appeals and complaints.

n9bd3d959418.s: Which of the following pairs relating to committees on the Civil Services Examination is wrongly matched?
o: D.S. Kothari Committee – Introduction of the three-stage examination system
Satish Chandra Committee – Review of the Kothari scheme and introduction of an essay paper
Y.K. Alagh Committee – Introduction of the three-stage examination system
P.C. Hota Committee – Civil service reforms
n9bd3d959418.x: The Y.K. Alagh Committee reviewed the CSE system; the three-stage examination came from the D.S. Kothari Committee.

n2478f9bc182.s:
Assertion (A): The Fourth Report of the Second ARC was titled 'Ethics in Governance'.
Reason (R): The Tenth Report of the Second ARC was titled 'Refurbishing of Personnel Administration – Scaling New Heights'.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n2478f9bc182.x: Both titles are correct, but the title of one report does not explain the title of another.

n86612ebe33b.s: Which Article of the Constitution deals with the All India Services?
n86612ebe33b.x: Article 312 concerns All India Services; 309 covers recruitment, 311 safeguards and 320 PSC functions.

ncf020b495b5.s: Fixed tenure and Civil Services Boards to insulate civil servants from political pressure were recommended in which case?
ncf020b495b5.x: Fixed tenure and Civil Services Boards are associated with the T.S.R. Subramanian case and the Second ARC.

nfcd205d87b2.s: Who chaired the Second Administrative Reforms Commission constituted in 2005?
nfcd205d87b2.x: M. Veerappa Moily chaired the 2nd ARC (31 August 2005), which gave 15 reports, the first on RTI as the 'Master Key to Good Governance'.

ndfa1965c85d.s: The cadre-controlling authority for the Indian Police Service is the:
o: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
ndfa1965c85d.x: MHA controls the IPS cadre; DoPT controls the IAS and MoEFCC the Indian Forest Service.

n46ac332e852.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the 2018 amendment to the Prevention of Corruption Act?
o: Bribe-giving became a direct offence punishable with up to seven years
A coerced bribe-giver is protected only if the matter is reported within 30 days
Commercial organisations are liable for bribes offered on their behalf
It sought to align Indian law with the UN Convention against Corruption
n46ac332e852.x: A coerced bribe-giver must report within 7 days, not 30.

n3b82af81b76.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about proceedings under the Fugitive Economic Offenders Act, 2018?
o: An arrest warrant must have been issued
The value involved is ₹100 crore or more
The person has fled from India
Property can be confiscated only after conviction
n3b82af81b76.x: On the ED's application, the Special Court may confiscate property even before conviction.

n980834ca830.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about sanction for prosecution of public servants?
o: Since 2018, Section 19 sanction under the PC Act also covers retired public servants
Section 218 of the BNSS, corresponding to Section 197 CrPC, came into force on 1 July 2024
Section 19 of the PC Act requires government approval before a police inquiry begins
Approval before an inquiry or investigation is governed by Section 17A of the PC Act
n980834ca830.x: Prior approval before inquiry or investigation is Section 17A; Section 19 concerns sanction for prosecution.

n0b1d32eab4f.s:
Assertion (A): Under the Whistle Blowers Protection Act, 2014, revealing a complainant's identity is punishable with imprisonment up to three years and a fine up to ₹50,000.
Reason (R): A knowingly false complaint under the Act attracts the same punishment.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
n0b1d32eab4f.x: A knowingly false complaint attracts a lighter punishment of up to 2 years and ₹30,000, so R is false.

n16fe964641c.s: The Whistle Blowers Protection (Amendment) Bill, 2015 lapsed with the dissolution of the:
n16fe964641c.x: The Bill would have barred disclosures in Section 8(1)-type categories; it lapsed with the 16th Lok Sabha in 2019.

n0c15252362d.s: Which body exercises superintendence over the CBI in corruption cases?
n0c15252362d.x: The CVC supervises the CBI in corruption cases; the CBI rests on the DSPE Act, 1946, and the ED on the PMLA and FEMA.

n37478fb1546.s: Under Section 2(c) of the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988, which of the following does NOT correctly describe a 'public servant'?
o: An employee of a local authority
Only a permanent employee of the Union Government
A person whose office requires performance of a public duty
n37478fb1546.x: The definition covers local-authority employees, Judges and persons performing public duties; it is not limited to permanent Union employees.

n801263a3d30.s: The Santhanam Committee was the Committee on:
n801263a3d30.x: The Santhanam Committee was the Committee on Prevention of Corruption; the CBI followed in 1963 and the CVC in 1964.

ncec20346422.s: In which year did India ratify the United Nations Convention against Corruption?
ncec20346422.x: The Convention was adopted in 2003, India signed it in 2005 and ratified it in 2011.
